# {{ site.en-author }} ({{ site.title }})

> {{ site.en-description }}

{{ site.en-author }} (Chinese name {{ site.title }}, handle shisaq) is a video editor in China who tests local AI models on a Mac mini home server and writes up what works, with measured numbers: speed, memory, power draw and cost. The blog has run since 2015. Posts are written in Chinese first; the technical ones have English versions under /en/.

- English RSS: {{ site.url }}/en/feed.xml
- Sitemap: {{ site.url }}/sitemap.xml
